lessons.title: Bonjour ! Greetings and politeness
lessons.objective: Greet people, say goodbye, thank and apologise, and choose between tu and vous.

lessons.title: The letters and sounds of French
lessons.objective: Say the alphabet, spell words aloud, read accents, and know which final letters are silent.

lessons.title: Je m'appelle… Introducing yourself
lessons.objective: Introduce yourself and others with s'appeler and être, using subject and stressed pronouns.

lessons.title: Countries, nationalities and languages
lessons.objective: Say where you are from, your nationality and the languages you speak.

lessons.title: Avoir, numbers 0–69 and your age
lessons.objective: Use avoir, count to 69, and give your age and phone number.

lessons.title: Jobs and workplaces
lessons.objective: Say what you do and where you work; masculine and feminine job names.

lessons.title: Articles and gender
lessons.objective: Use un, une, des and le, la, l', les; ask Qu'est-ce que c'est ? and Qui est-ce ?

lessons.title: Everyday verbs in -er
lessons.objective: Conjugate regular -er verbs in the present and say what you do every day.

lessons.title: French vowels: u, ou, é, è, eu
lessons.objective: Hear and say the vowel contrasts that change meaning: [i]/[y], [y]/[u], [e]/[ɛ], [ø]/[œ].

lessons.title: Likes, dislikes and negation
lessons.objective: Say what you like and don't like, and make sentences negative with ne… pas.

lessons.title: Asking questions
lessons.objective: Ask questions with intonation, est-ce que and question words.

lessons.title: My family
lessons.objective: Talk about your family with possessive adjectives.

lessons.title: Describing people
lessons.objective: Describe people with adjectives that agree, and with très and trop.

lessons.title: Things and colours
lessons.objective: Name everyday objects and colours, and point things out with ce, cet, cette, ces.

lessons.title: Nasal vowels
lessons.objective: Hear, say and spell the nasal vowels [ɛ̃], [ɑ̃] and [ɔ̃].

lessons.title: Aller, faire, venir, prendre
lessons.objective: Use four key irregular verbs and the contractions au, aux, du, des to talk about leisure and sport.

lessons.title: Telling the time and daily routine
lessons.objective: Tell the time and describe your day with pronominal verbs.

lessons.title: Days, dates, seasons and weather
lessons.objective: Say the date, name days, months and seasons, and talk about the weather.

lessons.title: Around town
lessons.objective: Name places in town and say where things are with il y a and prepositions of place.

lessons.title: Finding your way
lessons.objective: Ask for and give directions using the imperative.

lessons.title: Food and quantities
lessons.objective: Talk about food with du, de la, des and quantities like un kilo de.

lessons.title: Shopping and prices
lessons.objective: Count to a thousand, ask prices and buy things in a shop.

lessons.title: At the café and restaurant
lessons.objective: Book a table and order politely with je voudrais.

lessons.title: Clothes and sizes
lessons.objective: Talk about clothes, sizes and colours, and ask quel / quelle.

lessons.title: Can, want, must; invitations
lessons.objective: Use pouvoir, vouloir, devoir and il faut; invite, accept and refuse; make appointments.

lessons.title: Home sweet home
lessons.objective: Describe your home, its rooms and furniture.

lessons.title: Transport and travel
lessons.objective: Get around by train, bus and metro and buy a ticket.

lessons.title: Health and the body
lessons.objective: Name parts of the body, say where it hurts, and explain why with parce que and pour.

lessons.title: Plans: the near future
lessons.objective: Talk about your plans with aller + infinitive and time expressions.

lessons.title: What I did: the passé composé
lessons.objective: Say what you did and have just done, with the passé composé and venir de; write a postcard.

lessons.title: Back to the past: the passé composé
lessons.objective: Use the passé composé with être and pronominal verbs, with the right agreement.

lessons.title: When I was a child: the imparfait
lessons.objective: Describe how things were and what you used to do with the imparfait.

lessons.title: Telling a story: passé composé or imparfait?
lessons.objective: Choose between the passé composé and the imparfait, and hear j'ai parlé vs je parlais.

lessons.title: Anecdotes and memories
lessons.objective: Tell an anecdote in order with d'abord, puis, ensuite, enfin, pendant and depuis.

lessons.title: Direct object pronouns
lessons.objective: Replace things and people with le, la, l', les.

lessons.title: Indirect object pronouns
lessons.objective: Use lui and leur with verbs like parler à, téléphoner à, donner à.

lessons.title: Y and en
lessons.objective: Use y for places and en for quantities.

lessons.title: Qui, que, où
lessons.objective: Join sentences with the relative pronouns qui, que and où.

lessons.title: Comparing
lessons.objective: Compare people, places and things with plus, moins, aussi and the superlative.

lessons.title: Describing people in detail
lessons.objective: Describe looks, clothes, character and relationships.

lessons.title: Life stories
lessons.objective: Tell someone's life story and write a short portrait.

lessons.title: The future: futur simple
lessons.objective: Make predictions and promises with the futur simple.

lessons.title: Not any more, nothing, nobody
lessons.objective: Use ne… plus, ne… rien, ne… personne and ne… jamais.

lessons.title: Instructions and advice
lessons.objective: Give instructions, directions and advice, including the imperative with pronouns.

lessons.title: Verbs with à and de
lessons.objective: Use verbs followed by à or de: commencer à, arrêter de, penser à, essayer de.

lessons.title: How often and how much
lessons.objective: Say how often and how much with tout, souvent, parfois, assez and peu.

lessons.title: Congratulations and good wishes
lessons.objective: Exclaim with quel, que, comme; congratulate, wish and compliment.

lessons.title: Giving your opinion
lessons.objective: Agree, disagree and give an opinion; say what you liked or didn't like.

lessons.title: Why, so, in order to
lessons.objective: Give causes, consequences and purposes.

lessons.title: Let's do something
lessons.objective: Suggest, invite, accept, refuse and organise an outing; on and its meanings.

lessons.title: On the phone
lessons.objective: Phone someone, leave a message, interrupt politely and check understanding.

lessons.title: Can I help?
lessons.objective: Offer and ask for help, say what you'd like to do, and warn someone.

lessons.title: At the doctor's
lessons.objective: Describe symptoms and how you feel, and follow a doctor's advice.

lessons.title: Work and jobs
lessons.objective: Talk about your work experience, workplace and colleagues.

lessons.title: School and studies
lessons.objective: Talk about the French school system, your studies and training.

lessons.title: Travel and holidays
lessons.objective: Book a hotel, describe a place you visited and solve problems while travelling.

lessons.title: Finding a flat
lessons.objective: Rent a flat, describe it and report problems.

lessons.title: In the kitchen
lessons.objective: Follow and give a recipe, with en for quantities.

lessons.title: Festivals and traditions
lessons.objective: Talk about French festivals and customs; possessive pronouns.

lessons.title: Writing to a friend
lessons.objective: Write a friendly letter or email to invite, thank, apologise or give news.

lessons.title: Telling a story well
lessons.objective: Combine the passé composé and the imparfait in a narrative with la veille, le lendemain and autrefois.

lessons.title: Before that: the plus-que-parfait
lessons.objective: Say what had already happened with the plus-que-parfait.

lessons.title: I would like…: the conditional
lessons.objective: Form the conditionnel présent and use it for wishes and politeness; tell parlerai from parlerais.

lessons.title: If you were me…
lessons.objective: Give advice and make suggestions with the conditional: tu devrais, à ta place, et si on… ?

lessons.title: If…: hypotheses
lessons.objective: Make hypotheses about the real and the imaginary with si.

lessons.title: Il faut que: the subjunctive begins
lessons.objective: Form the present subjunctive and use it after il faut que.

lessons.title: Wishes and feelings with the subjunctive
lessons.objective: Use the subjunctive after vouloir que, être content que, avoir peur que.

lessons.title: Subjunctive or indicative?
lessons.objective: Choose between them after espérer, croire, penser and their negatives.

lessons.title: In my opinion
lessons.objective: Express and justify an opinion, agree and disagree with nuance.

lessons.title: Feelings, hopes and ambitions
lessons.objective: Name feelings and talk about hopes, intentions and ambitions.

lessons.title: He says that…: reported speech
lessons.objective: Report statements and questions in the present.

lessons.title: Two pronouns together
lessons.objective: Use two object pronouns in the right order.

lessons.title: Y and en with verbs
lessons.objective: Replace à + thing with y and de + thing with en.

lessons.title: Dont and lequel
lessons.objective: Use dont and lequel, auquel, duquel.

lessons.title: C'est lui qui…: emphasis
lessons.objective: Highlight information with c'est… qui / que and ce qui, ce que, ce dont.

lessons.title: Some, each, none
lessons.objective: Use plusieurs, quelques, certains, chacun, and ne… que, ne… aucun, ni… ni.

lessons.title: The passive
lessons.objective: Say what is done, and by whom, with the passive.

lessons.title: En + -ant: the gérondif
lessons.objective: Express simultaneity, manner and condition with the gérondif.

lessons.title: Past participles with avoir
lessons.objective: Make the past participle agree with a direct object placed before it.

lessons.title: Explaining causes
lessons.objective: Explain causes with car, comme, puisque, grâce à, à cause de and en effet.

lessons.title: Consequences and purposes
lessons.objective: Express consequences and purposes, including pour que + subjunctive.

lessons.title: Although, however, despite
lessons.objective: Express opposition and concession.

lessons.title: The news
lessons.objective: Read headlines and news stories; turn verbs into nouns.

lessons.title: Fashion and style
lessons.objective: Talk about fashion; adverbs in -ment, environ, presque, autant.

lessons.title: Problems and complaints
lessons.objective: State a problem, propose solutions, and complain politely.

lessons.title: Formal letters and emails
lessons.objective: Write formal emails and letters with the right openings and closings.

lessons.title: Job interviews
lessons.objective: Talk about your experience in a job interview; conduct an interview.

lessons.title: Giving a presentation
lessons.objective: Present a topic or project in a clear order and conclude it.

lessons.title: Taking part in a discussion
lessons.objective: Take the floor, keep a discussion going, check understanding and rephrase.

lessons.title: Reviews: films, books and shows
lessons.objective: Review and recommend a film, book or show.

lessons.title: Summing up
lessons.objective: Summarise a short article or interview and give your view.

lessons.title: Studies, training and wellbeing
lessons.objective: Talk about education and training, and health and wellbeing.

lessons.title: Registers: how French changes with the situation
lessons.objective: Recognise formal, standard and informal French, including the way people really speak.

lessons.title: By then: the futur antérieur
lessons.objective: Say what will have happened by a point in the future.

lessons.title: I should have…: the conditionnel passé
lessons.objective: Express regret and reproach, and report unconfirmed news, with the conditionnel passé.

lessons.title: If I had known…
lessons.objective: Make hypotheses about the past; use avec, sans and au cas où.

lessons.title: Doubt, possibility and judgement
lessons.objective: Use the subjunctive after je doute que, il est possible que, il est normal que.

lessons.title: Subjunctive after conjunctions
lessons.objective: Use the subjunctive after avant que, sans que, bien que, pourvu que — or an infinitive instead.

lessons.title: The past subjunctive
lessons.objective: Use the past subjunctive for completed actions.

lessons.title: After having…: the past infinitive
lessons.objective: Use après avoir / après être + past participle.

lessons.title: Participles and the gérondif
lessons.objective: Use the present participle and verbal adjective, and tell them from the gérondif.

lessons.title: He said that he would…
lessons.objective: Report speech in the past with the right sequence of tenses.

lessons.title: Lequel and its forms
lessons.objective: Ask lequel ? and use preposition + lequel in relative clauses.

lessons.title: Past participle agreement: hard cases
lessons.objective: Handle agreement with pronominal verbs, en and fait + infinitive.

lessons.title: Certain, probable, doubtful
lessons.objective: Express degrees of certainty, probability and doubt.

lessons.title: Cause and consequence: going further
lessons.objective: Use en raison de, faute de, à force de, si bien que, de sorte que, tellement… que.

lessons.title: Opposition and concession: going further
lessons.objective: Use en revanche, néanmoins, toutefois, or, quoique, même si.

lessons.title: Aims and obligations
lessons.objective: Express purpose with en vue de, dans le but de, de crainte de, and obligation.

lessons.title: Building an argument
lessons.objective: Add and illustrate arguments with de plus, en outre, d'ailleurs, non seulement… mais encore.

lessons.title: Organising a text
lessons.objective: Plan a text with an introduction, thesis, antithesis and conclusion.

lessons.title: In other words: reformulating and concluding
lessons.objective: Rephrase and conclude: autrement dit, de toute façon, en définitive.

lessons.title: Debates and meetings
lessons.objective: Run or join a debate or meeting: invite others to speak, refocus, sum up.

lessons.title: Taking a stand
lessons.objective: Defend a position methodically, weighing advantages and disadvantages.

lessons.title: Hesitating and complaining
lessons.objective: Hesitate politely and handle a complaint on the phone.

lessons.title: Reading the press
lessons.objective: Read and analyse news articles, including the journalistic conditional.

lessons.title: The environment
lessons.objective: Discuss the environment, climate and ecology.

lessons.title: Society and values
lessons.objective: Discuss social trends and problems, politics and values.

lessons.title: The economy and work
lessons.objective: Discuss the economy and the world of work.

lessons.title: Science and technology
lessons.objective: Discuss science, technology and digital life; specialised vocabulary.

lessons.title: Arts and culture
lessons.objective: Discuss and analyse films, books and art.

lessons.title: Feelings, relationships and idioms
lessons.objective: Talk about feelings and relationships in depth, with common idioms.

lessons.title: Studies and summaries
lessons.objective: Summarise a text with its positions; academic and professional writing.

lessons.title: The passé simple
lessons.objective: Recognise and read the passé simple and passé antérieur.

lessons.title: Narrating: récit and discours
lessons.objective: Choose tenses and moods for narration and description.

lessons.title: Literary language and style
lessons.objective: Recognise narrative, descriptive, lyrical and burlesque styles.

lessons.title: Nuance and hedging
lessons.objective: Attenuate and qualify what you say.

lessons.title: Cause: going further
lessons.objective: Use considérant que, d'autant plus que, surtout que, étant donné que.

lessons.title: Consequence: going further
lessons.objective: Use à tel point que, au point que, si… que.

lessons.title: Concession: going further
lessons.objective: Use encore que, quand bien même, avoir beau, si… que + subjunctive.

lessons.title: Purpose: going further
lessons.objective: Use veiller à ce que, de crainte que, de peur que.

lessons.title: The expletive ne and formal negation
lessons.objective: Recognise and use ne explétif, nul, nulle part and literary ne.

lessons.title: Hypotheses: full mastery
lessons.objective: Handle all hypothetical structures, including formal inversion.

lessons.title: Emphasis and word order
lessons.objective: Use dislocation and cleft sentences for emphasis.

lessons.title: Inversion
lessons.objective: Use subject inversion after peut-être, aussi, ainsi, sans doute and in formal questions.

lessons.title: Developing an argument
lessons.objective: Support a point with secondary arguments and examples; manage transitions and digressions.

lessons.title: The synthèse
lessons.objective: Summarise and combine several documents objectively.

lessons.title: The argued essay
lessons.objective: Plan and write an essai argumenté.

lessons.title: The oral presentation
lessons.objective: Give an exposé from documents and discuss it.

lessons.title: Analysing discourse
lessons.objective: Analyse polemical, political and diplomatic texts; implicit meaning.

lessons.title: Irony, humour and tone
lessons.objective: Recognise and convey irony, humour, exasperation and cynicism.

lessons.title: Idiomatic French
lessons.objective: Understand and use common idiomatic expressions.

lessons.title: Quoting and reporting
lessons.objective: Quote and report others' views with precise reporting verbs.

lessons.title: Politics and institutions
lessons.objective: Discuss politics, institutions and social values.

lessons.title: The economy and business
lessons.objective: Discuss the economy and business at an advanced level.

lessons.title: Law and justice
lessons.objective: Discuss law and justice.

lessons.title: History and memory
lessons.objective: Discuss history and collective memory.

lessons.title: Science and research
lessons.objective: Discuss science and research.

lessons.title: French around the world
lessons.objective: Recognise varieties of French in Québec, Belgium, Switzerland and Africa.
